raw: [name="Tin Man"]Oh... I remember them... I see now.
speaker: Tin Man
content: Oh... I remember them... I see now.

raw: [name="Tin Man"]It's a cruel twist of fate, Kal'tsit, but you'll have children so young face their fate head on?
speaker: Tin Man
content: It's a cruel twist of fate, Kal'tsit, but you'll have children so young face their fate head on?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]This is their decision. I have no right to intervene.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: This is their decision. I have no right to intervene.

raw: Kal'tsit silently looks at Trimounts shrouded in dark clouds in the distance.
content: Kal'tsit silently looks at Trimounts shrouded in dark clouds in the distance.

raw: Its tall skyscrapers remain under the thick, dark clouds; its base hidden by the fields around them.
content: Its tall skyscrapers remain under the thick, dark clouds; its base hidden by the fields around them.

raw: Likewise, the Tin Man lifts his head.
content: Likewise, the Tin Man lifts his head.

raw: Up in the sky above the city and the entire lands, at an unreachable altitude that mankind has dreamt of reaching for thousands of years—
content: Up in the sky above the city and the entire lands, at an unreachable altitude that mankind has dreamt of reaching for thousands of years—

raw: —A burning fireball is tearing through the skies like a falling star.
content: —A burning fireball is tearing through the skies like a falling star.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Ifrit, do you want to hear a story?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Ifrit, do you want to hear a story?

raw: [Subtitle(text="A story... Alright. Today's story takes place in a beautiful city in Sargon...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: A story... Alright. Today's story takes place in a beautiful city in Sargon...

raw: [Subtitle(text="There was once a well-respected king, loved by his people, but when he finally grew old, he had an anxious look on his face, never calming down for even a second.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: There was once a well-respected king, loved by his people, but when he finally grew old, he had an anxious look on his face, never calming down for even a second.

raw: [Subtitle(text="He gave it his all to rule his city, but he found that not one thing in the city would bear his mark forever. His statues would crumble, and his legends would fade. People forget too easily.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: He gave it his all to rule his city, but he found that not one thing in the city would bear his mark forever. His statues would crumble, and his legends would fade. People forget too easily.

raw: [Subtitle(text="In the final days of his life, he eagerly hoped for there to be something that could truly symbolize his whole legacy and ensure that it would be told for generations to come.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: In the final days of his life, he eagerly hoped for there to be something that could truly symbolize his whole legacy and ensure that it would be told for generations to come.

raw: [Subtitle(text="And so, he asked his wife. He hoped to find this treasure with her together.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: And so, he asked his wife. He hoped to find this treasure with her together.

raw: [Subtitle(text="They searched all over the lands and found a bottomless pit of gold, clothing that restored youth, a magic mirror that allowed its user change races at will, a sword that could rend mountains, and a treasure map that led to mythical realms.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: They searched all over the lands and found a bottomless pit of gold, clothing that restored youth, a magic mirror that allowed its user change races at will, a sword that could rend mountains, and a treasure map that led to mythical realms.

raw: [Subtitle(text="None of these were what the king wanted. They were all too specific, and the desires they bore were too strong. The old king did not think any of these could represent his legacy.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: None of these were what the king wanted. They were all too specific, and the desires they bore were too strong. The old king did not think any of these could represent his legacy.

raw: [Subtitle(text="This left the queen stricken with grief. She prayed to the night skies that her husband would get his wish. Finally, hearing her faithful prayers, a star arrived in the mortal realm—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: This left the queen stricken with grief. She prayed to the night skies that her husband would get his wish. Finally, hearing her faithful prayers, a star arrived in the mortal realm—

raw: Ifrit stares blankly at the blazing red tail sweeping through the sky.
content: Ifrit stares blankly at the blazing red tail sweeping through the sky.

raw: She suddenly recalls a story out of the thousands that Silence has told her.
content: She suddenly recalls a story out of the thousands that Silence has told her.

raw: Legend has it, there is always hope wherever a star so happens to land. The differences that divide mankind are mended the moment the star reaches the ground, and everyone's wishes will be fulfilled all at once.
content: Legend has it, there is always hope wherever a star so happens to land. The differences that divide mankind are mended the moment the star reaches the ground, and everyone's wishes will be fulfilled all at once.

raw: Will a star come falling down? There's no time to think. Time is flying by.
content: Will a star come falling down? There's no time to think. Time is flying by.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I wish for—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I wish for—
